note: Subject layer of the Candy look proposal, direction CHOCOLATIER (bead pulp_wars-jdb.10). Every recipe of the run is an edit, which sends only its instruction: each line records the look the edit asks for. Exploration only; see ../PROPOSAL.md.

subjects.UNIT:CANDY:FIGHTER/CHOCOLATIER: Subject: Dip the toffee soldier in dark chocolate: the lower half of the toffee cube is coated in dark chocolate #4a2412 with a lighter #7a4526 highlight, with a wavy dripping edge across its middle, so the upper half with the face stays golden toffee; the knob on top and the feet are dark chocolate; the wrapper wings become cream white with thin gold stripes. Keep the face, the lollipop, the chocolate shield, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:GUARD/CHOCOLATIER: Subject: Change three things only. The big biscuit shield becomes a thick slab of dark chocolate bar marked into square blocks #4a2412 with lighter #7a4526 edges. Its feet and the lowest quarter of its body are dipped in dark chocolate with a wavy edge. The pink frosting on its top becomes golden caramel #e0a040. Do not redraw anything else: keep the white marshmallow body, the face, the cheeks, the arms, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:MARKSMAN/CHOCOLATIER: Subject: Recolour only the base under the glass globe: the mint green base becomes milk chocolate #7a4526, shaded dark chocolate #4a2412, with one caramel gold band #e0a040, round its top edge; its two eyes become cream-white dots with black pupils. No mint green is left. Keep the globe and its gumballs, the dark lid, the gold coin knobs, the flying gumball, the feet, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT/CHOCOLATIER: Subject: Recolour and change nothing else: every mint green crystal chunk of the golem becomes a block of dark chocolate #4a2412, with lighter milk chocolate #8a5330 facets and small cream highlights; the brown bands at its joints become bright caramel gold #e0a040, dripping; its face becomes pale cream #fff1d0, with dark eyes; the crest on its head is golden toffee crystal. No green is left. Keep every shape, the pose, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
subjects.CITY:CANDY:2/CHOCOLATIER: Subject: Recolour as a chocolate cake town and change no shape: the pink frosting dripping over the round cake keep becomes dark chocolate glaze #4a2412, over cream sponge; the roofs of the little houses become dark chocolate with white cream piping; the pink gumdrops on the wall become caramel gold #e0a040; doors dark chocolate; the lollipop becomes caramel and cream; one small pink cherry on top of the keep. Keep every shape, the size, outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:BATTLESHIP/CHOCOLATIER: Subject: Recolour as a chocolate cake galleon and change no shape: the hull becomes layers of dark chocolate sponge #4a2412, with thin cream filling stripes and a thick caramel gold rim #e0a040, in place of the pink frosting; the sails stay cream white; the masts become caramel gold and cream stripes; the pennants caramel gold; the cake tower dark chocolate with white cream on top. Nothing pink is left. Keep every shape, the size, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
